actions.create_form.description: Create a form based on an existing template form.
actions.create_form.props.enabled.descri: Whether the created form should be enabled. If not set, inherits from template.
actions.create_form.props.form_name.desc: The name of the new form (must be unique).
actions.create_form.props.logic_rules.de: Advanced logic rules for the form.
actions.create_form.props.navigation_con: Conditions for navigation rules. Reference the navigation rule by its index (0-based).
actions.create_form.props.navigation_rul: Define how users navigate between steps.
actions.create_form.props.step_progress_: Edit progress bar elements on steps.
actions.create_form.props.steps.descript: Define the steps for your form.
actions.create_form.props.template_form_: Select the template form to copy from.
actions.delete_form.props.confirm_delete: Check to confirm deletion. This action cannot be undone.
actions.export_submission_pdf.descriptio: Create a PDF export for a specific form submission.
actions.export_submission_pdf.props.form: Select the form to export submission from.
actions.export_submission_pdf.props.user: Select the user whose submission to export.
actions.list_form_submissions.descriptio: List submission data for a particular form.
actions.list_form_submissions.props.coun: Limit the number of returned submissions.
actions.list_form_submissions.props.crea: Limit submissions to after this creation time.
Limit submissions to before this creation time.
actions.list_form_submissions.props.end_: Limit submissions to before this update time.
actions.list_form_submissions.props.fiel: Search for submissions with specific field values.
Comma-separated list of field IDs to return.
actions.list_form_submissions.props.form: Select the form to get submissions for.
actions.list_form_submissions.props.fuzz: Fields and terms for fuzzy search. Weights must sum to 1.
Score threshold between 0 and 1 for fuzzy search.
actions.list_form_submissions.props.no_f: Don't return field data. More performant for large datasets.
actions.list_form_submissions.props.page: Number of results per page (default 500, max 1000).
actions.list_form_submissions.props.sort: How to sort the returned field values.
actions.list_form_submissions.props.star: Limit submissions to after this update time.
actions.list_form_submissions.props.use_: Use cached data for faster response (may be a few minutes old).
actions.update_form.description: Update a form's properties including status and translations.
actions.update_form.props.enabled.descri: Whether the form should be enabled or disabled.
actions.update_form.props.translations.d: Add translations for form text. Note: This will override existing translations.
auth.description: Your Feathery admin API key. You can get an API key by creating an account.
description: Build powerful forms, workflows, and document automation.
triggers.file_submitted.description: Triggers when a file is submitted in your form, or when a document is signed/generated.
triggers.file_submitted.props.document_i: The ID of the document template to monitor.
triggers.file_submitted.props.lookup_typ: Choose how to find document envelopes.
triggers.file_submitted.props.user_id.de: Select the user to monitor for file submissions.
triggers.form_completed.description: Triggers when a form is completed by an end user.
triggers.form_completed.props.form_id.de: Select the form to monitor for completions.
triggers.new_submission.description: Triggers when a user submits data through your form.
triggers.new_submission.props.form_id.de: Select the form to monitor for submissions.
